bootstrap.weighting: All comparisons in each sampled paper; pooled comparison-level metrics
bootstrap.limitations: Intervals are exploratory with few source papers and condition on the observed papers. They do not measure variation from training seeds, model selection, or annotation uncertainty. No interval is reported with fewer than two source papers.

mcnemar.interpretation: Descriptive only: assumes independent comparison pairs, which may fail within source papers.
